novel_mechanics_found: The horizontal ordering strip requires the exact head-to-tail color sequence 8 -> 12 -> 9 -> 14, while the initial vertical rack is 14 -> 9 -> 8 -> 12 from top to bottom. L3 is sequence-sensitive: blocks must be staged with alternating vertical carries and horizontal retract/extend transfers so the active chain accumulates the target prefixes [8], [8,12], [8,12,9], then [8,12,9,14]. A detached block follows horizontal retraction only after it has first been threaded while pinned to the perpendicular vertical chain and carried beyond that chain's endpoint.
narrative: The mandatory resolver returned the 44-label results/arc_loop_solve_sk48.json prefix, and a fresh reset replay reached levels_completed=2. Compact component dumps mapped the bottom guide exactly as [8,12,9,14] and the vertical rack as [14,9,8,12]. Live probes confirmed that carrying a fully threaded block beyond the vertical rack changes how retraction transports it. I then searched the source-grounded legal ACTION1-4 transition model from the exact live L3 state for the ordered match predicate, finding intermediate prefixes [8,12] and [8,12,9] before a 37-action L3 tail. A newly constructed offline environment replayed the complete 81-label sequence from reset; labels 44-80 remained at level 2 and label 81 advanced the returned frame to levels_completed=3. The fresh gate ended on level 4 with GameState.NOT_FINISHED.
gotchas: The guide order is read from the bottom head outward: 8, then 12, then 9, then 14; the vertical rack's top-to-bottom order is not itself the target.
Correct per-color contact is insufficient. The active chain's simultaneously encountered colors must form the exact ordered prefix at each staging phase.

A block still pinned by the perpendicular vertical chain behaves differently from an already detached block: pinning lets the horizontal endpoint pass through it, while an unpinned block can be pushed ahead of the endpoint.
The winning action starts the success flash and immediately returns the next level, so post-trigger sprite colors can be remapped even though frame_level correctly reports 3.
Use a newly constructed environment for trustworthy replay; the successful reproduction used a fresh Arcade environment and reset.
